purpose: First screen of the pages whose hero text or chips changed in the traffic revision (T4, T5), the three new guides, the two changed articles and the homepage, before (production 5ad00a6c build) and after (this build). Chromium (playwright-core), JavaScript on, fonts loaded, five viewports. Boxes of the H1, the intro under it (.speakable-intro, the speakable text), the primary and secondary CTA and the trust chips; their pairwise overlaps, boxes outside the viewport width and horizontal page overflow. The two chats are byte-identical and were not re-run (their own check is scripts/chat-layout-check.mjs).
notes: No overlap of H1, intro, CTAs and chips, nothing outside the viewport and no horizontal overflow on any page at any size.

The hero CTA below the first screen is not new on phones: on the SMM and targeting pages it was already below at 320×568 and 360×640 in production. New: on /uz/smm-xizmatlari/ at 375×667 the longer intro (23 → 42 words, five lines → eight) moves it from 626 px to 710 px; on /uz/instagram-target-yoqish/ (a new page) it sits at 682 px. On every one of these pages the header button and the fixed bottom bar («Qo‘ng‘iroq qilish» / «Ariza», «Позвонить» / «Заявка») stay in the first screen, so a contact action is always visible.

Prices in the new intros wrap at the thousands space at 360–375 px («2» at a line end, «490 000» on the next line), as the existing price chips and the RU targeting intro already did; content uses plain spaces site-wide, no change in this revision.
